# S394 — TUI: text field start cue, short build notice, heard cue from last output

*Proposed.* Every text field whose start has scrolled off begins with `...`. The stale-build notice in the status line reads `restart daemon`. The heard cue of an engine run with no ledger run counts from the role's last output.

**Findings:** 2026-11-17: re-verified at HEAD f48a6154. A scrolled text field does not mark its hidden start; with the daemon-build notice the status line drops vendor fields at 80 columns; an engine run with no ledger run turns `!!` 30 minutes after its role started even while the role writes output. The S228 draft's field-cue item moves here (S228's field-cue slice is dropped). · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

TUI half (lines and cues) of the S227 notes row, plus the field cue of the S228 draft. Re-verified at HEAD `f48a6154`:

- S171 item 6 (still present). `textField.parts` moves `start` right until the cursor fits and returns the text from `start` with no mark (`internal/tui/field.go:62-73`). Every one-line field uses `textField`: the answer and fix fields (`internal/tui/pane.go:95`), compose (`internal/tui/compose.go:16,19`), relay answer (`internal/tui/relayanswer.go:82`), matrix edit (`internal/tui/matrix_edit.go:40-43`), saved-wave name (`internal/tui/savedwaves.go:23-25`), welcome path (`internal/tui/welcome.go:21`), spec-check answer (`internal/tui/speccheck.go:660`); the lineup budgets call `parts` directly (`internal/tui/lineup.go:377`).
- S169 item 5 (still present). The status line puts the daemon notice, then one `V out until T` field per vendor, then drops fields from the end until the line fits (`internal/tui/view.go:613-647`). The stale-build notice is `daemon build differs: ork daemon restart` (`view.go:631`, 40 columns). With it, `claude out until back` and `codex out until 17:02` the line is 89 columns, so at 80 the codex field goes. With `restart daemon` (14 columns) the same line is 63 columns.
- S182 item 5 (still present). `engineBoard` takes the newest role `StartedAt` or `EndedAt` as the run's `UpdatedAt` (`internal/tui/relayboard.go:508-531`), and `lastHeard` turns `!!` past 30 minutes (`relayboard.go:181-198`). The snapshot carries each running step's `last_output` (`source.EngineWork`, `internal/source/source.go:254-260`, field `Working` at `:293`, S235), which no TUI code reads. `docs/dashboard.md:716-717` documents the current behaviour.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): a leading `...` marks a scrolled-off start in every text field (adj 444, supersedes adj 421); the stale-build notice becomes `restart daemon` instead of folding the vendor fields (adj 429); `!!` counts from the role's last output (adj 427). S171 item 5 (`N note` against `ctrl+d/u`) is retired, the order kept (adj 431).

The behind-main notice does not follow. adj 429 names the stale-build notice only. The behind notice is a different message: it says the daemon is behind main and, with a `build_command`, that `--rebuild` is needed (`daemon.BehindNotice`, `internal/daemon/build.go:17,173-186`). Its full text is shared with `ork doctor` and `ork status` (`docs/dashboard.md:2454-2468`), and the TUI already shortens it to `behind main: ork daemon restart` below 52 columns (`view.go:619-625`, `docs/dashboard.md:2451-2452`, S315 at `:2471-2475`). `restart daemon` would drop both the cause and `--rebuild`. It stays as it is; the owner can ask for it separately.

Not in this slice: the behind-main notice; any daemon or CLI text (`ork doctor` and `ork status` keep their warnings); the hint drop order.

## Implement

Tests first, then:

1. `field.go` `parts`: when `start > 0` and `width >= 6`, return `"..."` plus the tail of the text before the cursor that fits in `width - 3 - width(cursor)`. Keep the rest as it is. This covers every field, `lineup.go:377` included.
2. `view.go:631`: the stale-build notice reads `restart daemon`. Leave the behind notice (`view.go:619-625`) and `daemon.BehindNotice` as they are.
3. `relayboard.go` `engineBoard`: take the newest non-zero `LastOutput` of `r.Working` as a candidate for `updated`, like the role times.
4. Docs, `docs/dashboard.md`: the stale-build notice reads `restart daemon` (adj 429), and the behind notice keeps its text; a text field whose start has scrolled off begins with `...` (adj 444); for an engine run with no ledger run the cue counts from the role's last output, or its start before the first output (adj 427). Mark each *proposed*.
5. Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the diff in `testdata/golden/`; only the stale-build status lines (`version-stale-mono-*.txt:24`) may change.
6. CHANGELOG.md: one new bullet at the end of `## Unreleased` (S227).
7. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

- The behind-main notice and its short form are unchanged.
